meta.title: Farming enchantment cost research
meta.purpose: Machine-readable level-aware acquisition-cost research for Farming420's upgrade planner.
meta.scope: Current farming-relevant enchantments and endcap upgrades that materially affect farming output, progression, pest strategy, rare-crop strategy, or farm operation.
exclusions: Generic non-farming enchantments with no meaningful farming decision value
Sunder as an active enchantment; it was removed in the 0.24.4 Farming update
meta.priceBasis: Indexed SkyCofl last-24-hour average/median snapshots captured during research. Crawl ages vary, so these values are fallback snapshots rather than live market truth.
meta.runtimePriceRule: Fresh Hypixel Bazaar data must override snapshot prices whenever a Bazaar product exists. For exact execution cost use the relevant buy-side/order model, not a global arithmetic average.
meta.analyticsRule: Mean prices are reporting/research metrics only. Upgrade recommendations must calculate the exact currentLevel -> targetLevel path for the physical item.

normalCombine.rule: For a normally combinable enchantment, two equal-level books create the next level.
normalCombine.incrementalExistingLevelRule: If an item already has level L, upgrading to L+1 needs one additional level-L book or the cheapest legal equivalent from lower books. Do not use marketPrice(L+1)-marketPrice(L).
normalCombine.cheapestFreshApplyRule: min(directTargetLevelMarketCost, legalCombineFromLowerLevelsCost) when both paths are valid and sufficiently fresh.

specialLevels.rule: Do not derive endcap or progression-only levels by doubling the previous level unless the game explicitly allows that path.
examples: Dedication IV is a special top level, not two Dedication III books.
Harvesting VI is a special book/drop, not two Harvesting V books.
Pesterminator VI is reached from Pesterminator V with A Beginner's Guide to Pesthunting.
Cultivating II-X are earned by crop-count progression, not by buying/combining more Cultivating books.
Turbo-Crop VI/VII use Turbo Gourd / Enchanted Turbo Gourd; exact multi-enchant application semantics remain VERIFY for planner implementation.

physicalItemMultiplier.rule: Enchant costs are item-local. Multiply only by the number of separate physical items that need the enchant.
examples: Pesterminator and Sunset on all four armor pieces: per-piece cost x4.
Green Thumb on all four equipment pieces: per-piece cost x4.
Tool enchantments: calculate per owned physical tool; shared-tool state must not be duplicated.

xpLevels.rule: Anvil/application XP levels are stored separately from coin cost. Convert XP to coins only when a separate, sourced XP procurement model exists.

earnedTime.rule: Progression-only levels keep direct coin cost and active grind time separate.

primaryRuntimeSource.name: Hypixel Public API Bazaar
primaryRuntimeSource.notes: Official API exposes buy_summary, sell_summary and quick_status. quick_status buyPrice/sellPrice are weighted averages of the top 2% of orders by volume.

researchSnapshotSource.name: SkyCofl
researchSnapshotSource.notes: Indexed last-24-hour average and median values used below. These snapshots are intentionally marked fallback because their crawl dates vary.

enchantments.name: Harvesting

acquisition.level6: Special rare Shiny Pig book; do not derive as two level V books.

enchantments.plannerRule: For a player at Harvesting V, V->VI cost is the current Harvesting VI book cost.

enchantments.name: Cultivating

acquisition.level1: Purchased for 4,000 Bits or traded on Bazaar.
acquisition.levels2to10: Earned automatically by crop-count progression on the physical tool; no further books are purchased.

enchantments.plannerRule: Coin acquisition is paid once at level I. Higher-level cost is remaining crop progression plus optional time-value conversion; never multiply the level-I book price by powers of two.

effect.type: Matching Crop Fortune per Crop Milestone tier

acquisition.4: Special Visitor reward/direct book; not created by combining two Dedication III books.

derivedMethod.2: 2 x level-I average is cheaper than direct level-II snapshot.
derivedMethod.3: 4 x level-I average is cheaper than direct level-III snapshot.

enchantments.name: Replenish

effect.description: Automatically replants supported crops; no fake Farming Fortune value is assigned.

acquisition.craft: 16 Enchanted Cookie + 24 Paper at Cocoa Beans VIII; also obtainable from Librarian visitor.

enchantments.plannerRule: Value through preserved farm throughput/integrity, not through a fabricated Fortune stat.

enchantments.name: Delicate

effect.description: Prevents breaking certain farm-sensitive blocks; no direct Farming Fortune.

acquisition.5: Anita: 2 Silver Medals + 32 Jacob's Tickets; also tradeable.

enchantments.plannerRule: Keep medal/ticket acquisition and tradeable market opportunity cost separate. No reliable 24h-average snapshot was captured in this pass.

enchantments.name: Feast

acquisition.1: Feast Baker Scott: 25 Kernels; tradeable book.

enchantments.plannerRule: At this snapshot every direct level II-V book is cheaper than rebuilding that level solely from level-I books.

enchantments.name: Crop Fever

acquisition.1: Crafted from Jukebox + 16 Compacted Moonflower at Moonflower VII; tradeable.

enchantments.plannerRule: Use proc expected value/uptime rather than treating the active +100 FF/+15 Overbloom as permanently active.

enchantments.name: Green Thumb

effect.type: Farming Fortune per unique Visitor served, per enchanted equipment piece

enchantments.plannerRule: Calculate each equipment piece independently; a full four-piece setup is four applications.

enchantments.name: Sunset

effect.stacking: Each enchanted armor piece contributes independently.

enchantments.plannerRule: Use daytime Overbloom only during the daytime state; do not apply it globally at night. Four-piece cost is four independent applications.

enchantments.name: Pesterminator

effect.stacking: Each enchanted armor piece contributes independently.

acquisition.6: Apply A Beginner's Guide to Pesthunting to Pesterminator V; guide costs 500 Pests from Pesthunter Phillip and is tradeable.

analytics.directSnapshotCoverage: 4/5 normally traded enchant levels; VI is an endcap item

enchantments.plannerRule: VI incremental cost from an existing V item is only the guide/endcap cost, not a second Pesterminator V stack. Four armor pieces require four independent guides.

turboCrop.normalLevels: I-V are normal Turbo-Crop enchant levels. IV/V have contest-medal progression requirements historically documented; modern exact VI/VII gating should be reverified before enforcing a gate.
turboCrop.derivedAverageCombinePathCaveat: Levels I-V use mean known level-I snapshot x 2^(L-1). VI/VII then add snapshot endcap costs. This is an analytical fallback, not guaranteed cheapest market execution and excludes 3 missing level-I variant snapshots.
turboCrop.plannerRule: Use exact crop variant and exact current item state. Query fresh target-level and component prices. Do not use the cross-variant mean for an actual upgrade recommendation.
turboCrop.endcapApplicationSemantics: VERIFY before implementing multi-enchant optimization; do not assume one endcap purchase upgrades every Turbo line on an item until current live behavior is verified.

legacy.name: Sunder
legacy.rule: Do not include in live farming recommendations, item maxing, or cost totals.
